name: Todoroki Keigo
source:
Favorite Color: White
Special Skills: Having Strange Dreams/Eating Heavenly
Hobby: Searching for Data/Napping
Feelings Toward the Protagonist: An Important Pupil/I have to properly take care of her!

He's a relative of Ryou's.
